name: HYDRA-UMC-VOICE-UI
notes: Real v0 audio front-end (WAV loading + energy-gate voice activity detection, stdlib-only), rule-based intent/entity parser over already-transcribed text, and a bounded Watch voice-turn HTTP gateway. Server now relays authenticated client requests to a loopback CM5 service while retaining the gateway token; replies require primary-control confirmation for motion. Whisper STT / neural TTS still require their real model/runtime dependencies.
